hypothesis: Promote private17..64-byte mixed4/8-byte records in the existing SRA pass, bounded to256 new medium lanes per function. The follow-up Sol audit identified eligible-looking private slots in retained IR.
validation: Both prototypes self-built; v1 passes388 focused and599 quick tests, v2 passes381 focused and599 quick tests. Both mixed-field probes pass native default/release/debug and web default/release with independent expected result42. No full/laptop campaign for regressions already exposed by instruction counts.
decision: The second prototype unifies whole-record copy layouts and removes all targeted mixed-record loads/stores, yet whole-compiler instruction counts rise1.3–4.5%. Added optimizer/register-allocation work does not pay for itself. Retain the current small-slot implementation; do not broaden this prototype without a materially cheaper analysis or different evidence.

fresh_frame_attribution.mapping: A diagnostic emitter recorded frame ranges while compiling the accepted compiler source. Its emitted .text is byte-identical to the sampled accepted native compiler. Non-unique normalized function names are excluded from frame mapping. Three instruction-PC samples of the44,005-line default workload, with independently checked generated numeric output.
limits: Retired-instruction PCs sample instruction addresses, not precise memory-latency or removable cost.
Only direct RBP-relative memory accesses are mapped; pointer aliases and indexed addresses remain unclassified.
Frame-slot-or-padding includes slots larger than64 bytes and alignment padding.
Calls and inlining can move cost between functions.
fresh_frame_attribution.interpretation: Direct spill accesses and callee-save accesses exceed medium-record accesses. These fractions are sampled instructions, not removable-time budgets. The previous native/GCC pair remains the matched host comparison; this fresh accepted-native-only run attributes its stack accesses.
fresh_frame_attribution.artifact_recovery: The initial objcopy dump command rewrote a cache executable. It was restored from the laptop copy and checked against its original build.json SHA-256 before sampling. The corrected reproducible script supplies a separate output path. No source or committed artifact was affected.

next: Inspect actual register lifetime/call-save decisions, especially cold allocation calls that currently induce hot-path callee saves; do not repeat a broad SRA expansion merely by increasing budgets.
